prompt.project_info: Create a high-angle seaside balcony selfie with a playful holiday mood.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult Asian woman with shoulder-length dark brown bob, windblown strands, fair warm skin, natural Korean makeup, coral lip tint, and a warm wink, wearing an opaque beige ribbed long-sleeve top with a secure neckline and delicate heart pendant.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle 4:5 upper-body selfie, head tilted slightly right, glass balustrade, sandy beach, ocean waves, wooden deck, wind moving hair, no cleavage emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright overcast seaside daylight with diffuse shadows, breezy open-air vacation atmosphere, slight motion blur in hair and organic smartphone texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 smartphone selfie, slightly tilted high angle, natural bokeh, realistic skin and hair texture, soft exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-angle 4:5 selfie of an approved adult Asian woman on a seaside balcony. She has a shoulder-length dark brown layered bob, chaotic windblown strands, fair warm skin, natural Korean makeup, soft coral lip tint, a delicate silver heart pendant, and a playful wink with a closed smile. She wears an opaque beige ribbed long-sleeve top with a secure neckline. Include a glass balustrade, sandy beach, foamy ocean waves, and wooden deck. Use soft overcast daylight, diffuse shadows, natural bokeh, slight motion blur on hair, and an organic high-definition smartphone look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, low-cut top, visible cleavage, tight body emphasis, sexualized expression, nudity, boyfriend perspective, personal caption text, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, balcony, ocean, windblown hair, beige knit, wink, and holiday mood; replace identity or accessories with approved equivalents. Keep typography and caption text absent.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced low-cut cleavage styling, flirtatious wording, and boyfriend-perspective framing with secure coverage and a playful public selfie.
